# Offroad Bumpis

Offroad Bumpis is a bumperball rental service in Malmö, Sweden, serving all of Skåne.

## Core facts
- Children balls: ages about 7–12, maximum 60 kg.
- Adult balls: from age 12, maximum 90 kg, bookable for dates from 2026-09-01.
- Inventory: up to 12 children balls and 12 adult balls.
- Prices: children balls from 600 SEK; adult balls from 700 SEK.
- Pickup in Malmö: 0 SEK. Delivery in Skåne can be booked by zone.
- Included: battery pump, battery, charger, transport bags and instructions. Two pumps for 6 or more balls.
- Allowed surfaces: an ordinary even lawn, artificial grass, sports hall, fine sand and soft snow. Renting a venue is not required. As an optional tip, search for "<city> Rbok" to find local booking for a sports hall or a proper football pitch; the venue is booked separately.
- Not allowed: asphalt, gravel, concrete, ice or hard uneven surfaces.
- Contact: kontakt@offroadbumpis.se, +46 79 344 25 20.
- Booking: https://offroad-bumpis-booking.onrender.com/
- Booking flow: the booking system checks inventory for the selected period, reserves available equipment directly and emails an invoice plus payment details.
- Payment deadline: no later than three business days before handover unless otherwise agreed. Unpaid reservations may be released automatically.
- Rental periods: a normal day is 08:00–20:00. Friday 08:00 through Sunday 20:00 counts as one price day. Other multi-day periods are calculated per price day.
- Cancellation: full refund no later than three calendar days before the rental starts. Later cancellations are charged but credited toward a new booking within six months.
